name: Move Workflow
description: Orchestrate and Direct your Move Transition filters in OBS Studio. Using the Workflow canvas you can create complex workflows that control the movement of your scenes and filters in real-time.
author: DuhBuhHuh

website.footerLabel: Complete Control of your Move Filters.

hero.title: Move Workflow
hero.intro:
Move Workflow adds a layer to [[link:https://github.com/exeldro/obs-move-transition|[[yellow:Exeldro's Move Transition Plugin]]]] for OBS Studio.

Move Transition defines the action, Move Workflow decides when it happens, what happens simultaneously, and what happens next.

experience.title: Orchestrate your Move filters.
experience.text: Build complex OBS workflows that control when Move Transition filters run, what happens together, and what happens next.

features.title: Visual workflow editor
features.text: Build workflows by adding Trigger and Action nodes and connecting them together.

features.title: Move filter actions
features.text: Run existing Move Action, Move Source, Move Source Swap and Move Value filters.

features.title: Scene changes
features.text: Change the active OBS scene as part of a workflow.

features.title: Parallel actions
features.text: Start several actions together or continue to the next action after timing completes.

features.title: Precise timing
features.text: Use the existing filters timings or override the Start Delay, Duration and End Delay.

features.title: Persistent workflows
features.text: Workflows are saved and restored when OBS starts.

features.title: Import and export
features.text: Move workflows between installations using .obsworkflow.json files.

media.title: Ban/Timeout Widget Demo
media.caption: See the Ban/Timeout Widget in action.

media.title: Workflow Canvas
media.caption: The canvas is where you manage and connect your filters, set what filters run sumultaneously and what filters run next.

media.title: Configure and override filter settings independently of the original move filter settings.
media.caption: Configure the filter using the node settings

media.title: Node Connection types
media.caption: Simultaneous - Run all connected nodes at the same time.\nNext - Run the next connected node after the current node completes.\nShortcut - Run the next connected node when the configured hotkey is pressed.

requirements: OBS Studio 31.x or a compatible version supported by the build.
[[link:https://github.com/exeldro/obs-move-transition|Exeldro's Move Transition plugin for Move actions]].

setup.title: Get the plugin running.
setup.intro: Install the plugin, restart OBS, then open the workflow editor and create your first workflow.

steps.title: Download the plugin
steps.description: Download current release of the Windows x64 package above.

steps.title: Install the plugin
steps.description: Extract the downloaded ZIP and copy the plugin files into your OBS root directory.

images.alt: Copy the bin folder to your obs root directory.

steps.title: Install Move Transition
steps.description: Install Exeldro's [[link:https://github.com/exeldro/obs-move-transition|Move Transition plugin]]. This is a required plugin for Move actions to work properly.

steps.title: Restart OBS
steps.description: Close and restart OBS Studio so the plugin is loaded.

steps.title: Open Move Workflow
steps.description: In OBS, from the top menu bar open Tools > Move Workflow.

steps.title: Create a workflow
steps.description: Open the workflow manager and create a workflow with a useful name.

steps.title: Add a Trigger node
steps.description: Add a Trigger node and give it a name that describes what it starts, such as Start Intro or Show Camera.

steps.title: Add Action nodes
steps.description: Add the Move or Change Scene nodes you need to your workflow. Configure the source, filter, timing and Easing for your nodes.

steps.title: Connect the nodes
steps.description: Connect nodes to decide which actions run together and which action runs next.

steps.title: Add a Trigger Workflow filter
steps.description: Add a Trigger Workflow filter to an OBS source and select the workflow and Trigger node that should start it.

steps.title: Test the workflow
steps.description: Activate the trigger and check the OBS log or enable Debug in the workflow editor if you need more information.

notes: Move Workflow does not replace Move Transition. Move Transition performs the actual Move operation; Move Workflow controls sequencing.
Easing and Easing Function are shown in workflow data for future use but are not implemented in 1.1.0.
